name: civsim
description: Repo task runner. Thin aliases over cargo (Rust) and the web app's own bun scripts (bun run --cwd web ...); no dependencies of its own. cargo and web/package.json stay the source of truth — these just give one front door and the cross-language combos.

scripts.fmt: cargo fmt --all && bun run --cwd web format
scripts.fmt:check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && bun run --cwd web format:check
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && bun run --cwd web test && bun run --cwd web test:ui
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test --workspace && bun run --cwd web lint && bun run --cwd web typecheck && bun run --cwd web format:check && bun run --cwd web test && bun run --cwd web test:ui
